findings.title: Fee-free pass-through at minimum amounts
findings.description: Input swap fee = mulDiv(1, 1, 10000) = 0. A 1 wei input with 1 BPS fee pays zero fee. This is mathematically correct floor rounding but means sub-fee-threshold amounts transit fee-free.
findings.exploit_potential: None. The amount passing fee-free (1 wei) has negligible economic value. Output swap charges ceil(1, 1, 9999) = 1 wei fee, so the asymmetry favors protocol on reverse.
findings.verification: Forge test passes. Fee asymmetry confirmed: input rounds down (user pays less), output rounds up (user pays more). Net: protocol-favorable.

findings.title: uint128 truncation in _getTokensOwed (theoretical)
findings.description: FullMath.mulDiv(feeGrowthDelta, liquidity, Q128) can return values > uint128.max that get silently truncated when cast to uint128. Demonstrated with delta=2^129, liquidity=uint128.max.
